title: Evaluation under pair encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $r$ be a finite bit string, and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $2n+2+|r|$ inputs, whose gates read only earlier vertices and whose output is a vertex of the circuit. For every assignment $v$ of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs, the circuit obtained by wiring each input bit twice, followed by $01$ and then $r$, evaluates to the same Boolean value as $C$ evaluated on that encoded input.
hypotheses_covered: Each gate of $C$ reads only earlier vertices

$v$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
